paragraphs.source_en: Just as this thought occurred to him, Ieyasu calmly said again, “There is no need to worry. Tokugawa Ieyasu is doing all that man can do to contend against the gods and Buddhas. This time, I am determined not to pray for divine protection.”

units.source_en: Just as this thought occurred to him, Ieyasu calmly said again, “There is no need to worry. Tokugawa Ieyasu is doing all that man can do to contend against the gods and Buddhas.
units.source_zh: 正想到此，只听家康又平静道：“不必担心，德川家康乃是在尽人事与神佛对抗。

units.source_en: This time, I am determined not to pray for divine protection.”
units.source_zh: 这次我偏偏不祈求神佛庇佑。”

paragraphs.source_zh: 正想到此，只听家康又平静道：“不必担心，德川家康乃是在尽人事与神佛对抗。这次我偏偏不祈求神佛庇佑。”

paragraphs.source_en: In fact, Ieyasu’s arrangements were flawless.

units.source_en: In fact, Ieyasu’s arrangements were flawless.
units.source_zh: 事实上，家康的安排天衣无缝。

paragraphs.source_zh: 事实上，家康的安排天衣无缝。

paragraphs.source_en: On the twentieth, news arrived that Mitsunari and Ōtani Yoshitsugu had joined forces and entered Osaka Castle.

units.source_en: On the twentieth, news arrived that Mitsunari and Ōtani Yoshitsugu had joined forces and entered Osaka Castle.
units.source_zh: 二十日，三成与大谷吉继携手进入大坂城的消息传来。

paragraphs.source_zh: 二十日，三成与大谷吉继携手进入大坂城的消息传来。

paragraphs.source_en: According to letters relayed by Chaya Shirōjirō and Hōkōji, Mōri had been persuaded by Ankokuji Ekei, rejected Kikkawa Hiroie’s counsel, and gone personally to Osaka Castle, where he entered the western enclosure.

units.source_en: According to letters relayed by Chaya Shirōjirō and Hōkōji, Mōri had been persuaded by Ankokuji Ekei, rejected Kikkawa Hiroie’s counsel, and gone personally to Osaka Castle, where he entered the western enclosure.
units.source_zh: 据茶屋四郎次郎和丰光寺承兑的书函看来，毛利已被安国寺惠琼说服，拒绝了吉川广家的劝说，亲自到了大坂城，进入西苑。

paragraphs.source_zh: 据茶屋四郎次郎和丰光寺承兑的书函看来，毛利已被安国寺惠琼说服，拒绝了吉川广家的劝说，亲自到了大坂城，进入西苑。

paragraphs.source_en: Ieyasu had his secretaries make copies of every one of these letters for each commander and distribute them individually. Although the commanders had anticipated such a turn of events, they were still deeply troubled and could not help growing agitated. Unexpectedly, Ieyasu’s actions kept them from competing to claim the honors of battle.

units.source_en: Ieyasu had his secretaries make copies of every one of these letters for each commander and distribute them individually.
units.source_zh: 所有这些书函，家康全部让佑笔给每位将领抄了一遍，一一分发到他们手中。

units.source_en: Although the commanders had anticipated such a turn of events, they were still deeply troubled and could not help growing agitated.

ja.t: してはいたものの、やはりひどく

units.source_zh: 诸将虽已料到会发生这种事，但还是异常担心，不免骚动起来。

units.source_en: Unexpectedly, Ieyasu’s actions kept them from competing to claim the honors of battle.
units.source_zh: 令人意外的是，家康的这些做法竟避免了他们争抢战功。

paragraphs.source_zh: 所有这些书函，家康全部让佑笔给每位将领抄了一遍，一一分发到他们手中。诸将虽已料到会发生这种事，但还是异常担心，不免骚动起来。令人意外的是，家康的这些做法竟避免了他们争抢战功。

paragraphs.source_en: Were they to fight in the east, or in the west? Until that question was resolved, no one could begin fighting.

units.source_en: Were they to fight in the east, or in the west?
units.source_zh: 究竟是要打东边，还是要打西边？

units.source_en: Until that question was resolved, no one could begin fighting.

ja.t: めることはできなかった。

units.source_zh: 这个疑问解不开，就无法开战。

paragraphs.source_zh: 究竟是要打东边，还是要打西边？这个疑问解不开，就无法开战。

paragraphs.source_en: That same day, the great army set out from Edo Castle in a mighty procession, just as planned.

units.source_en: That same day, the great army set out from Edo Castle in a mighty procession, just as planned.
units.source_zh: 同日，大军照原定计划浩浩荡荡从江户城出发。

paragraphs.source_zh: 同日，大军照原定计划浩浩荡荡从江户城出发。

paragraphs.source_en: “It appears he truly means to attack Uesugi.”

units.source_en: “It appears he truly means to attack Uesugi.”

paragraphs.source_en: “Our lord is so composed; he must already have a brilliant plan.”

units.source_en: “Our lord is so composed; he must already have a brilliant plan.”

ja.t: としておられるのだ。きっと

units.source_zh: “大人如此悠然，定是早有妙计。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “大人如此悠然，定是早有妙计。”

paragraphs.source_en: Needless to say, the hatamoto commanders accompanying him were perplexed, and even the commanders of the vanguard found it puzzling. Ieyasu, however, remained entirely unhurried and took three days to reach Oyama in Shimotsuke. In Shimotsuke, he received another urgent report from the west. This time it was a letter from Torii Mototada at Fushimi Castle, reporting that Mōri Terumoto had entered Osaka Castle and that Fushimi Castle would probably fall within days.

units.source_en: Needless to say, the hatamoto commanders accompanying him were perplexed, and even the commanders of the vanguard found it puzzling.

units.source_en: Ieyasu, however, remained entirely unhurried and took three days to reach Oyama in Shimotsuke.
units.source_zh: 家康却不慌不忙，花了三日才到下野小山。

units.source_en: In Shimotsuke, he received another urgent report from the west.
units.source_zh: 在下野，他又接到西面飞报。

units.source_en: This time it was a letter from Torii Mototada at Fushimi Castle, reporting that Mōri Terumoto had entered Osaka Castle and that Fushimi Castle would probably fall within days.

ja.t: するだろう、とのことであった。

units.source_zh: 这次是来自伏见城的鸟居元忠来函，说是毛利辉元已进入大坂城，恐怕不日伏见城就要陷落云云。

paragraphs.source_zh: 同行的旗本大将不用说，就连先发诸将也都纳闷。家康却不慌不忙，花了三日才到下野小山。在下野，他又接到西面飞报。这次是来自伏见城的鸟居元忠来函，说是毛利辉元已进入大坂城，恐怕不日伏见城就要陷落云云。

paragraphs.source_en: Ieyasu concealed none of this from the commanders. Far from hiding it, he even added: “Any man whose heart is troubled may do as he pleases at any time. Ieyasu will place no obstacle in his way…”
